_help: Settings for the Etsy sync (scripts/etsy-sync.mjs). See README.md, 'Fixing what the sync decided'. categoryRules: checked in order against each NEW listing's Etsy title, shop section and tags; the first match picks its menu section. sectionCategories: an Etsy shop section name (or part of one) that always goes to a menu section, checked before categoryRules. subjectRules: every subject whose words match is added as a filter. merge: an Etsy listing id that should join an existing product (listing id → product id). keepSeparate: Etsy listing ids that should never be merged with another listing. skipTitles and ignoreListingIds: listings never added to the site. maxNewPerRun and maxGonePerRun: safety stops. maxPhotos: photos kept per product.
